about_the_game:
Proxima B

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A short Sci-fi adventure game made for the Game Boy Color in GB Studio! Solve puzzles, collect energy for your weapons, and fight the alien Ackloids to claim the planet Proxima B for the humans!

-The Demo only contains the intro and first level sequences of the full game

Features

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  • Puzzle-based level progression

  • Unique enemies and creatures

  • 5 levels, each with unique bosses

  • Full 8-bit soundtrack and art style

  • Player color customizer

Story

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Earth is in ruins after a large asteroid hit it about 10 years ago. You sign up to be an IASA Combat Astronaut to help fix your home world, as well as find a new one. You were assigned to help survey the land and "tame" the planet for human colonization. But, disaster strikes when you and your co-pilot, Xelendra (Xel), land.

Another alien race, the Ackloids, are attempting to colonize the planet for themselves and aren't up for any negotiations. With an attack on the human command ship, the only other human who can help is an injured Xel.

Will you have what it takes to defeat the Ackloids and save the human race? Find out in

Proxima B
